head.h1: Housewarming Catering in Dubai — What It Costs and How to Book

opening_paragraph: Housewarming catering in Dubai starts from AED 700 per person — a vetted private chef plans the menu, cooks in your new home, serves your guests and clears everything away. That means no borrowed serving dishes, no last-minute supermarket run and no washing-up at midnight, so you can give the tour and enjoy the night instead of hiding in the kitchen. Send over the date, guest count and venue, and during our published business hours you will hear back promptly, with an itemised proposal to follow.

new_paragraphs: How much does housewarming catering cost in Dubai?
Housewarming catering in Dubai starts from about AED 700 per person, with the final figure set by guest count, menu and how much service you want. Send your numbers for an itemised quote.
What is included in housewarming catering?
Everything: menu design, a private chef cooking on site, service staff, equipment, plating and full cleanup afterwards, so you host while we handle the food.
How far ahead should I book housewarming catering?
A week is usually enough for a small gathering; book earlier for large parties and peak dates such as New Year and Eid weekends.
Can you cater a housewarming in an apartment with a small kitchen?
Yes. The chef preps off-site and finishes on arrival with portable burners and warming equipment, so a compact apartment galley or an unpacked new kitchen is no problem.
Do you offer halal and dietary-friendly housewarming menus?
Yes. Halal, vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and nut-free options are all available and collected at booking so every guest is looked after.
How many guests can you cater for a housewarming?
From an intimate dozen to a house party of eighty-plus. Share your numbers and we scale the menu, staffing and equipment to match.
What is the cheapest way to cater a housewarming — and what do the packages cost?

Drop-off and buffet formats are the cheapest per head, because you are paying for food and not for a service team on the floor; a chef cooking and serving on site sits at the top of the range, from AED 700 per person. If you would rather see one number than build a quote, myCHEF publishes fixed packages at AED 1,200, 2,400, 3,600, 4,500 and 5,500, each covering menu, chef, service staff, equipment, setup and cleanup for a defined guest band. Larger guest counts bring the per-head figure down, so the cheapest version of a housewarming is usually a simpler format for more people rather than a smaller evening. See catering packages for what sits inside each tier.
What makes the best housewarming catering in a brand-new home?

Assume the kitchen is not ready. The set-ups that work prep off-site, arrive self-contained with burners and warming equipment, need one power point and a flat surface instead of your oven, and leave with every tray and bin bag. Anything that depends on your new kitchen being unpacked, the dishwasher being plumbed in or the bins being sorted is the version that goes wrong on the night. The second test is movement: a grazing table or passed canapés keeps guests walking through the home they came to see, which is the whole point of a housewarming.

Ready to plan? Request a housewarming catering proposal or chat on WhatsApp , and we will send an itemised quote. For housewarming catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

add_block.new_heading: Housewarming catering for house parties, families and corporate moves
new_paragraphs: Whether your housewarming is a laid-back family lunch or a buzzing evening party, the catering flexes to match. For a casual open house, grazing tables and canapés let guests drift, graze and chat while you show off each room. For a seated family dinner, a plated or sharing-style menu turns the new dining table into the centrepiece. We also handle corporate housewarming catering — office relocations, new showrooms and studio openings where a company wants to mark the space with something better than supermarket platters. Housewarming party catering works equally well by the pool, on a terrace or across an open-plan living area, and the team reads the room so food arrives in waves, not all at once. We cater private celebrations and housewarming catering for events across Dubai, so tell us the vibe — relaxed, elegant or celebratory — and the menu, pacing and staffing are tuned to it.

new_paragraphs: The housewarming menu is entirely bespoke, but most hosts start from a few crowd-pleasing formats. Grazing tables piled with Mediterranean mezze, artisan cheeses, cured meats, dips and warm breads suit a mingling crowd. Passed canapés and finger food keep things elegant and light in the hand. Live stations — a pasta bar, a shawarma or slider counter, a fresh-carved roast — add theatre and let guests build their own plate. Round it off with a dessert table and a mocktail or drinks setup. Cuisines range from Italian and Mediterranean to Arabic, Indian and pan-Asian, and each housewarming menu is designed around your guests, your budget and any dietary needs. Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and nut-free dishes sit naturally alongside the rest, each one labelled. If you have a signature dish that says home to you, the chef will happily build it into the spread.

add_block.new_heading: Styling, logistics and dietary needs in a new home
new_paragraphs: A new home comes with practical quirks, and a good caterer plans around them. If your kitchen is still unpacked boxes, or you have only a compact apartment galley, the chef prepares off-site and finishes on arrival with portable burners and warming equipment, so nothing depends on your oven. Service styling matters too: we can dress a bare console into a polished grazing display, or keep it deliberately relaxed with kraft boards and greenery. Parking, lift access and building rules in Dubai towers are confirmed ahead of time so the crew loads in smoothly. Dietary requirements are handled seriously — allergies, halal preferences and guest restrictions are collected at booking and built into the menu, not bolted on afterwards. Timing is choreographed so hot food stays hot and you are not left plating. The evening runs smoothly precisely because the logistics were solved before a single guest arrived.

add_block.new_heading: Why book housewarming catering with myCHEF?
new_paragraphs: MyCHEF was founded by a chef trained in some of Europe's most demanding kitchens, on one idea: you own the evening, we carry the work. Every chef working on housewarming catering has cleared identity checks, a practical cooking assessment, reference verification and ongoing performance reviews — a continuous standard, not a one-time tick. We are honest about it: no system removes every risk, so we match each event to the chef well suited to it. For a shareable, mingling housewarming, that is often Marco Rossi , whose Italian and Mediterranean cooking is built for generous grazing tables and relaxed sharing plates; he plans each menu with the host, balancing showpiece dishes with familiar crowd-pleasers. Our work spans housewarming catering, villa weddings, yacht celebrations and corporate galas across Dubai.

add_block.new_heading: Planning housewarming catering step by step
new_paragraphs: Send your date, guest count and venue — your housewarming catering proposal arrives.
Book housewarming catering about 2 weeks ahead off-peak, and 6 weeks ahead between November and March.
Confirm your housewarming catering menu about 7 days out, when the guest list is firm.
Ask early about allergies and dietary plates — not in the last 48 hours before housewarming catering.
Check the access route before housewarming catering day — setup starts roughly 2 hours ahead.
Plan on roughly 3 hours of housewarming catering service, and add 5% VAT to the total.
